technical.summary: Golden cross with strong long-term trend structure, but overbought conditions and short-term momentum divergence create pullback risk; moderate confluence with elevated caution warranted.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, minimal lobbying activity, and zero retail interest create a weak fundamental backdrop with elevated earnings risk in 33 days.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; market in fear (40 VIX-equivalent) with neutral AAII; insufficient data for conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (411.2) with flat yield curve and imminent NFP event create severe macro headwinds; 33-day earnings window adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross with price above major moving averages and bullish OBV divergence provides structural uptrend confirmation in a fear-zone opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis (411.2), overbought RSI-14 (72.2) with falling momentum, RSI-9 weakness (36.46), imminent earnings in 33 days, zero fundamental support, and price below Hull/TEMA create a perfect storm of pullback/reversal risk.
